recipe.title: Crispy Sesame Tofu & Broccoli Stir-Fry
recipe.description: A fast, restaurant-quality vegan stir-fry featuring golden crispy tofu and tender-crisp broccoli tossed in a savory garlic-ginger sesame sauce.

ingredients.item: extra-firm tofu, pressed and cut into 3/4-inch cubes
broccoli florets, cut into bite-sized pieces
avocado oil or high-heat vegetable oil

instructions.text: Pat the pressed tofu cubes dry with paper towels, place them in a bowl, and gently toss with cornstarch until evenly coated.

Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the tofu in a single layer and cook for 7 to 8 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden brown and crisp on all sides. Transfer tofu to a plate.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1/2 tablespoon of oil along with the minced garlic and ginger. Cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the broccoli florets and 2 tablespoons of water to the skillet. Cover immediately with a lid and steam for 3 minutes until crisp-tender and bright green.
Whisk together the tamari, maple syrup, toasted sesame oil, rice vinegar, and red pepper flakes in a small bowl.
Return the crispy tofu to the skillet with the broccoli, pour the sauce mixture over everything, and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until evenly coated and heated through.
Divide between two bowls and garnish with toasted sesame seeds and sliced green onions.

tips: Pressing the tofu for at least 10 minutes beforehand removes excess moisture, ensuring maximum crispiness.
Serve over brown rice, quinoa, or rice noodles for a complete meal.
